publicReleaseNotes:
**Published status-page snapshots no longer accumulate without limit in R2.** After a successful publication and pointer readback, Lamp keeps the current and previous snapshot generations and prunes older versions in bounded batches. An existing pile drains over successive successful publishes. A failed publication deletes nothing; deferred cleanup resumes on a later publish. Deployment removal clears snapshot objects with the rest of the files bucket.

The deployment guide explains the two-generation retention policy and its bounded cleanup. The checkout keeps rer 0.2.121.

Upgrading from 1.11.21: back up data and your source changes first, update the checkout to `v1.11.22`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations or contract meaning changes. Keep the backup, exercise a restored copy and check your installation's sign-in, first-run, Settings, incident and maintenance workflows and intended mail configuration. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and account credentials for `rer signin`. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including the migration introduced in 1.11.17, the mail-off instructions in 1.11.19 and keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.

migrations.buyerSteps: Back up data and owner source before deployment. After updating the checkout and installing frozen dependencies, rer deploy applies this migration after 0081 before starting the updated Worker. It allows reinstated maintenance to be cancelled again while retaining the unique scheduled, reminder, started and completed notices. Existing maintenance and notice history is preserved. Check cancellation, reinstatement and a second cancellation after updating. No new account or credential is required.

agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.21: back up data and owner source first, update the checkout to v1.11.22, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout pins @runeditrun/rer exactly 0.2.121) and rer deploy with the same environment and input file. This release adds no migrations or contract meaning changes. A fresh deploy resumes partially applied migrations while progress continues and checks the complete ledger before writing page settings. Name a second copy with --environment and leave LAMP_RESOURCE_PREFIX unset so the deployment owner claim can complete. Preserve the original deployment checkout, recorded ownership and Cloudflare account credentials for guarded rer signin to the selected environment's app Worker; signin cannot repair a failed owner claim. Preserve the intended enabled or disabled mail configuration: rer deploy defaults MAIL_PROVIDER to none, so select the intended provider explicitly for enabled email. For deliberate MAIL_PROVIDER=none follow the retained 1.11.19 notes and docs/deploy.md, including removal of conflicting sender, sending credentials, relay settings, DKIM inputs and secondary mail-provider configuration. The guides identify the checkout pin and distinguish it from the installed CLI version. Keep the pre-upgrade backup, exercise a restored copy and check sign-in, first-run, Settings, incident and maintenance workflows. Earlier installations follow the retained release-history records through 1.11.21, including the 0081 migration introduced in 1.11.17 and INSTALLATION_KEY custody. Preserve all published release records, immutable contract snapshots, applied migration history, owner customizations and recorded Worker names and hosting inputs. Run the existing verifier, release validator and affected owner workflows before adopting. After successful publication and pointer readback, R2 snapshot cleanup retains the current and previous generations and prunes older versions in bounded batches over successive publishes; a failed publication deletes nothing. Check the published status page after deployment. Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-17.
